purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S0-02. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: S0 STOP as above; S0-02 must show a non-zero signed I_G with KCL closing (post_run_checks.py: QTNLSC ACTIVE; I_G was exactly 0 in all 51 earlier runs).

At most 3 reserve launches on S0 repairs. If S0-02 still fails: gate tunnelling is reported as not implementable here; the leakage test falls back to the CALCULATED bounds plus the oxide-TAT runs (remove S2-04..S2-11 from the S2 plan).
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and refuses runnable=false plans

runs.label: c10_s0_02_2p0
runs.purpose: Smoke 2 / gate-leakage code path and first quantitative leakage result: S0-01 + self-consistent direct/FN-regime tunnelling QTNLSC.EL (qtnl.derivs) through Al2O3/HfO2 with the leakage-maximising oxide set, j.tun logged, oxide mesh 0.25 nm. Must show non-zero I_G and KCL pass; compares I_D(off) and I_G with the 2 nm floor (the smallest).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I_G at V_G=-3 V of order 1e-15..1e-11 A/um (Codex optimistic FN estimate 3.8e-12 A/um at 3 V), falling by >=3 decades between -3 and -1 V; I_D(off) slope |dlog10 I_D/dV_G| >= 1 dec/V where I_G dominates. Either outcome is reported. The worst set is an optimistic scenario (not a rigorous upper bound: no pinholes, thinning or defects), so floor-scale leakage here is an allowed result, checked by S2-11 (oxide mesh) before it is interpreted.
